svg.text: Datacern on Microsoft Azure — Deployment Architecture
As provisioned by the shipped IaC: deploy/terraform/azure (VNet · AKS · PostgreSQL Flexible Server · Event Hubs · Azure Cache · Storage · Key Vault · ACR) + Helm umbrella chart (values-azure.yaml)
Resource group + VNet — private subnets, Private Endpoints + Private DNS zones to every data service
resourcegroup.tf · network.tf · identity.tf (federated workload identity — no long-lived credentials in the cluster) · secrets_backend.tf
aks.tf — system + user node pools · workload identity federation · images from ACR (acr.tf)
Ingress — Application Gateway / LB → bff-graphql + ui-web
Helm umbrella chart, one Deployment per service,
• AI plane: agent-runtime, ai-gateway, memory, eval, tool-plane
• Data plane: ingestion, dataset, semantic, query, chart
• Governance: case, rbac, audit, notification, realtime-hub
Argo Workflows server: infra-gated add-on — orchestrator ships
the submit/watch client; server install is a deploy-time choice
only training Jobs schedule here; scales to zero
training without touching the services pool
pipeline runs are lease-held; a pod lost to scale-in or
eviction stops heartbeating and the orphan reaper
recovers the run on another instance — no stranded
migration 0004 · every instance sweeps, claim is one conditional UPDATE
Log Analytics workspace (terraform) · Prometheus rules + Grafana dashboards + ServiceMonitors (chart templates) · Tempo tracing
Azure Container Registry (acr.tf) — CI pushes images tagged by commit SHA; Helm pins global.imageTag at deploy
External Secrets Operator syncs Key Vault → k8s secrets (templates/externalsecret.yaml + secrets_backend.tf)
federated identity credentials (identity.tf) — pods assume Azure identities without stored secrets

g.text: Azure Database for PostgreSQL — Flexible Server
system of record · FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY per tenant · private endpoint only · non-superuser app roles at boot
postgres.tf
Azure Event Hubs — Kafka protocol
event backbone consumed through the Kafka API — services are unchanged · transactional outbox relay semantics preserved
eventhubs.tf
Azure Cache for Redis
consumer dedup, semantic-cache index, rate limits, sandbox-reaper leader election
redis.tf
Azure Storage — Blob
datasets (parquet), model artifacts, scoring outputs, audit archive · private endpoint + private DNS
Iceberg lakehouse tables live here behind the in-cluster REST catalog + Trino
storage.tf
Azure Key Vault
runtime secrets + keys, synced into the cluster via External Secrets · access policies scoped per workload identity
keyvault.tf
Private Endpoints + Private DNS zones
Postgres, Storage, Key Vault, Event Hubs reachable only inside the VNet — no public data-plane surface
network.tf
LLM providers — brokered by ai-gateway, never called directly by agents
Anthropic API (Claude) as configured per tenant; Azure-hosted model endpoints attach through the same gateway
seam · semantic cache, token budgets and cost metering sit in front of every call
Trust boundary notes
• Tenant isolation is enforced in Postgres (FORCE RLS) — not in application code an attacker could skip
• Audit chain hashes are verifiable off-platform; archive storage is private-endpoint-only
• Agent writes require a four-eyes approval that mints an RS256-signed execution grant — cloud IAM
compromise alone cannot make an agent's proposal execute

svg.text: dev / CI: docker-compose parity stack (same open-source images) — the tier where the 3,029-test evidence run executed.

cloud: this page — terraform apply (deploy/terraform/azure) then helm upgrade -f values-azure.yaml. Sibling stacks shipped for AWS, GCP and Hetzner — portability comes from every stateful dependency being open-source.

Honesty note: the AWS/GCP/Azure paths are the shipped, reviewed IaC — they are infra-gated and have not been exercised from the evaluation sandbox (no cloud credentials there). The executed-verification tier to date is local/CI.
Source: deploy/terraform/azure/*.tf, deploy/helm/datacern (values-azure.yaml), deploy/k8s/data-tier at commit 54cfe2d · generated 2026-07-30
